name: Side Panel for Gemini
description: Opens Gemini AI in Google Chrome's side panel

_execute_action.description: Opens the 'Side Panel for Gemini' extension

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; object-src 'self'; style-src * 'unsafe-inline' 'unsafe-hashes' 'self'; frame-src 'self' https://gemini.google.com/; connect-src 'self' https://gemini.google.com/;
